facts.fact: Kenya's State Department for Social Protection began migrating all Inua Jamii beneficiaries to the eCitizen-M-Pesa payment platform from the January 2025 disbursement, with funds collected from M-Pesa agents through USSD *222#.
The State Department requires every Inua Jamii beneficiary to hold a registered Safaricom line that matches their ID card to receive funds.
